info.title: Zinnia New Business Annuity API
info.description:
New Business — Annuity API surface exposed through Kong. This specification documents public health check endpoints for application validation, application processing, payment processing, TOA, eApp, and suitability services. **Version History** * Draft version 0.7.0
- Added V3 Annuity application submission endpoint (`/v3/new-business/annuity-applications`)
- V3 replaces the flat "role" model with a richer `Party` model (owner, beneficiary, agent, etc.) and moves bank details from the party to the payment
* Draft version 0.6.0
- added ETP endpoints Annuity V1, Annuity V2 and ETP health check
* Draft version 0.5.0
- New endpoints — expose `/eapp/actuator/health` and `/suitability/actuator/health` publicly through Kong
* Draft version 0.4.0
- New endpoint — expose `/toa/actuator/health` publicly through Kong
* Draft version 0.3.0
- New endpoint — expose payment processing health check publicly through Kong
* Draft version 0.2.0
- New endpoint — expose application processing health check publicly through Kong
* Draft version 0.1.0
- New endpoint — expose application validation health check publicly through Kong

x-changelog.change: Added V3 Annuity application submission endpoint (/v3/new-business/annuity-applications), introducing a Party model (replacing role) and moving bank details from party to payment. V3 schemas colliding by name with V1/V2 suffixed with V3.
added ETP endpoints Annuity V1, Annuity V2 and ETP health check
Expose `/eapp/actuator/health` and `/suitability/actuator/health` publicly through Kong for New Business — Annuity
Expose `/toa/actuator/health` publicly through Kong for New Business — Annuity
Expose payment processing health check publicly through Kong for New Business — Annuity
Expose application processing health check publicly through Kong for New Business — Annuity
Expose application validation health check publicly through Kong for New Business — Annuity
